contentHtml:
The UAE has made a bold move, strengthening its private sector by focusing on Emiratisation. Not only a strategy designed to boost the Emiratis’ employment in the workforce but also a chance to leave their footprints by excelling in their careers. Private sector businesses must have a proper knowledge of the Nafis program. It can help them tap into incredible benefits. Ultimately, support their hiring strategies and business growth.

But Nafis isn’t just about compliance with the rules. It’s about harnessing the Emirati talent potential. While making the most out of government-backed initiatives. It can save money, and increase efficiency. Even build a more sustainable workforce.

Therefore, wondering what exactly can Nafis offer your business. Read on to discover how this powerful initiative can enhance your company’s operations. In the meantime, attract top-tier talent, and help you thrive in a competitive market.

What Is Nafis? And what are Nafis Benefits?

The Nafis program is aimed to increase the participation of UAE nationals in the private sector. A combination of financial, professional, and strategic incentives are provided to businesses that employ Emiratis. Think of it as a win-win solution that helps you meet mandatory Emiratisation quotas. But also gives you access to a pool of highly skilled, government-supported talent.

Aiming to reduce hiring costs? Or enhancing your corporate image? Or building a more diverse workforce? Nafis offers tools and resources that can aid your business soar.

Why Should You Consider Nafis UAE?

If you’re in the private sector in the UAE, you need to get familiar with the Nafis program for several reasons:

  • Attract skilled Emirati talent: Gain access to a motivated and well-supported pool of professionals.
  • Financial support: Reduce overhead costs thanks to government-backed salary subsidies and pension contributions.
  • Long-term stability: Build a stable workforce with government-backed benefits and support.
  • Enhanced brand reputation: Show your commitment to local employment. It is highly valued by consumers and stakeholders.

Leveraging Nafis can give you a major edge in the UAE’s business environment.

Nafis Benefits for Employers: What’s in It for Your Business?

Let’s dive into the top benefits of participating in the Nafis program.

1. Salary Support: Cut Costs, Keep Quality

The salary support program is the most attractive feature of Nafis. The government provides a subsidy to cover part of an Emirati employee’s salary. This reduces the overall hiring cost of local talent. This makes it easier to attract highly skilled professionals without breaking your budget.

Why it’s beneficial for you?

Lower hiring costs =>Save money on salaries while hiring top-tier talent.

Competitiveness =>Stay competitive by offering attractive salary packages.

Resource allocation =>Allocate your savings to other areas.

2. Pension Contributions: Secure Long-Term Stability

Another significant perk under Nafis is the support for pension contributions. The government assists in funding the retirement savings of Emirati employees. This reduces the financial burden on employers.

Why it’s beneficial for you?

Lower financial liabilities =>You won’t have to fully shoulder the pension contributions.

Employee retention =>Offering pension benefits shows commitment to employee welfare.

Attract talent =>Strong pension plans are a key selling point for top candidates for job security.

3. Child Allowance: Show You Care About Family Life

Nafis offers child allowance incentives to Emirati employees, which can be a game-changer in boosting employee morale and retention. These allowances make private sector jobs even more appealing by supporting employees’ family life.

Why it’s beneficial for you?

Higher retention rates =>Employees stay loyal to a company that offers family-friendly benefits.

Improved employee loyalty =>A supportive work environment fosters stronger employee relationships.

Attract top talent =>Family-oriented perks attract candidates who value work-life balance.

4. Free Upskilling and Training Programs

Hiring the right talent is important. But so is ensuring that they must grow and stay competitive in their fields. Nafis provides access to vast upskilling and training programs at no cost to the employer.

Why it’s beneficial for you?

No training costs =>Save on expensive learning and development programs.

Highly skilled workforce =>Your employees will stay ahead of industry trends with the right skills.

Increased productivity =>Well-trained employees are more efficient and productive.

5. Recruitment Support: Simplified Hiring Process

The Emiratisation hiring process can be tricky. However, Nafis offers recruitment support to simplify things. From pre-screening to assistance with paperwork. This program ensures that your hiring process is smooth and efficient.

Why it’s beneficial for you?

Access to a pool of candidates =>Quickly connect with qualified Emirati talent.

Reduced recruitment time =>Cut down on the time spent on hiring.

Expert assistance =>Work with professionals who understand the Emiratisation process inside and out.

How Emiratisation Can Benefit Your Business Beyond Compliance

Emiratisation is more than just about meeting quotas. When executed strategically, it can serve as a cornerstone for your business’s long-term success. Here’s why:

Access to Government Incentives

The financial support, pension contributions, and training benefits provided by Nafis lower your hiring costs and make it easier to grow your business without worrying about additional financial burdens.

Enhanced Reputation and Consumer Trust

Demonstrate your commitment to local talent by participating in Emiratisation. Consumers and clients appreciate businesses that support local employment. As they are contributing to the community.

Diversity Drives Innovation

A diverse workforce brings fresh perspectives. You’ll have more innovative ideas by incorporating Emirati talent into your team. Their presence can foster a culture of creativity and growth. It’s a key to staying competitive in today’s market.

A Competitive Edge in the Market

Your business positions as a leader in the market by embracing Emiratisation. This leads to Nafis program benefits. Giving you a competitive edge, and attracting more clients, customers, and even partners.

A Quick Guide to Registering for Nafis

The Nafis benefits are clear, but the registration process can seem daunting. Don’t worry — we’re here to help you navigate the paperwork. Let’s get your business registered with ease.

Steps to Get Started with Nafis:

Step Action
Step 1 Visit the Nafis website and create an account.
Step 2 Submit company details and necessary documents.
Step 3 Verify compliance with Emiratisation quotas.
Step 4 Start hiring qualified Emirati candidates.

Final Thoughts: Make the Most of Nafis

Nafis offers significant opportunities to businesses. Specifically those willing to invest in Emiratisation. From salary support and pension contributions to recruitment assistance and upskilling programs. This program is a comprehensive initiative that benefits employers and employees. Your business can attract top talent by tapping into these resources. Also, reduces hiring costs, and enhances your market reputation.

Get Help With Expert’s Team

Ready to make Nafis work for you? If you need help in the Nafis registration process or finding the right Emirati talent, we’re here to guide you! Our assistance is to be with you at every step of the way. Let’s turn compliance into a competitive edge with Emiratisation Gate. We’ll drive your business toward long-term success.

Key Takeaways:

  • The Nafis program offers financial and recruitment benefits. These advantages aid businesses in hiring and retaining Emirati talent.
  • The program offers vast support tools like salary subsidies, child allowances, and upskilling opportunities.
  • Participating in Emiratisation enhances your business’s reputation. You’ll achieve sustainability and innovation.

FAQs

Q1. What is Nafis?

Nafis is a UAE federal program that supports Emiratis working in the private sector through financial benefits, training, and career development opportunities.

Q2. Who can apply for Nafis benefits?

UAE nationals aged 18–60 working or seeking jobs in the private sector are eligible for Nafis benefits.

Q3. What salary support does Nafis provide?

Emiratis in private-sector jobs can get monthly top-ups, reaching up to AED 8,000 in the first year of training.

Q4. Does Nafis support families?

Yes, Emirati employees can receive child allowances of up to AED 600 per child (for a maximum of four children).

Q5. What if an Emirati loses their job?

Nafis offers unemployment benefits for up to six months if the job loss occurs beyond the individual’s control.
